name: unic-archon-dlc
description: A config-driven Harness for the SDLC — the AI development lifecycle — as an installable Claude Code plugin — main line /specs → /tickets → /build → /pr-review → /qa, plus /triage, /explore, /improve-architecture, and /cleanup. Four Archon workflows (build, qa, pr-review, explore) with human approval gates; the rest are commands/skills composing Matt Pocock's methods.
